plugins.description: One skill, the whole MIT 18.S096 course: overnight strategy research (walk-forward, clustered t-stats, false discovery control, costs), a trading bot for the survivors, GARCH, Monte Carlo, Kelly, VaR, a risk gate, a broker step (paper by default, never without your yes), pairs, options, execution and 26 lecture notes.
